title: The affine almost-invariance lower-bound conjecture
statement:
Let $\varepsilon>0$, let $p$ be a prime, and let $A\subset\mathbb{F}_p\setminus\{0\}$. A nonempty set $X\subset\mathbb{F}_p$ satisfies the required affine almost-invariance conditions when

$$
|a\cdot X\setminus X|\leq\varepsilon|X|\quad\text{and}\quad |(a+X)\setminus X|\leq\varepsilon|X|
$$

for every $a\in A$, where $a\cdot X=\{ax:x\in X\}$ and $a+X=\{a+x:x\in X\}$. **The affine almost-invariance lower-bound conjecture.** For every $\varepsilon>0$, there is a constant $c_\varepsilon>0$ such that, for every positive integer $k\leq c_\varepsilon\log\log p$ and every prime $p$, there is a set $A\subset\mathbb{F}_p\setminus\{0\}$ with $|A|=k$ such that every nonempty $X\subset\mathbb{F}_p$ satisfying these conditions has

$$
|X|\geq\exp\bigl(\exp(c_\varepsilon k)\bigr).
$$

This conjecture predicts that the doubly exponential dependence in the affine construction cannot be improved; the supplied text does not establish its resolution.
source_name: Yufei Zhao, “Group representations that resist worst-case sampling”, arXiv:1705.04675 (2017).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.04675

Status: **refuted** according to the source (as of May 2017).
